description: THE TRAP. The brief's own example uses a product whose name is an ordinary fruit. Rewriting this makes Kivi worse than useless.
asr: i ate a kiwi for breakfast
formatted: I ate a kiwi for breakfast.
expected: I ate a kiwi for breakfast.
rationale: kiwi and Kivi are phonetically identical, so phonetics cannot settle this. No Kivi context term appears; 'ate' and 'breakfast' point the other way. The system must abstain.
A product name pluralised is already suspicious; combined with zero context support it must not fire.

description: Fruit surrounded by other food words.
asr: we had toast coffee and a kiwi
formatted: We had toast, coffee and a kiwi.
expected: We had toast, coffee and a kiwi.
rationale: Competing context. Nothing in the sentence belongs to the product's world.

description: Text is already canonical. Doing nothing here is correct, and must NOT be scored as an intervention.
asr: ask aaditya to review the sarvam kivi service
formatted: Ask Aaditya to review the Sarvam Kivi service.
expected: Ask Aaditya to review the Sarvam Kivi service.
rationale: Matching the canonical form is a no-op, not a rewrite. Counting it as a success would inflate the intervention numbers.

description: An email address is an identifier, not prose.
asr: email aditya at sarvam dot ai before noon
rationale: Rewriting inside an address breaks it. Protected spans are masked before matching.

description: A URL containing a memory-adjacent token.
asr: docs are at kiwi example dot com slash guide
rationale: A rewritten hostname is a broken link.

description: Inline code is verbatim by definition.
asr: run kiwi help to see options
rationale: A command name is not prose. Backticked spans are masked.

asr: at aditya please take a look
rationale: The handle may genuinely be spelled that way on the platform.

description: Two real people whose names nearly collide. Aaditya and Aditi are both active entries.
asr: ask aditi to join the sync
formatted: Ask Aditi to join the sync.
expected: Ask Aditi to join the sync.
rationale: similarity(aaditya, aditi) is 0.93 -- phonetics alone cannot separate them. Aditi is itself a known entry and matches exactly, so the margin rule must keep it.

description: One correction is a hypothesis, not a memory.
rationale: Prateik was corrected exactly once in the seed and is still a candidate. Acting on a single unconfirmed edit is how a memory system becomes annoying.

description: The user rejected this rewrite twice. The system must stop doing it.
rationale: Two contradictions suppress the entry. It stays inspectable and still explains why it declined to fire.

description: A name the system has never encountered.
asr: ask rahul to review the pull request
formatted: Ask Rahul to review the pull request.
expected: Ask Rahul to review the pull request.
rationale: No candidate, no intervention. Memory must not invent.

description: An ordinary word that appears in the seed's context sentences.
rationale: Being adjacent to a memory during learning does not make a word part of it.

description: KNOWN HARD. Sarah is a real person's name that sounds close to the Saaras model.
asr: sarah from marketing sent the deck
formatted: Sarah from marketing sent the deck.
expected: Sarah from marketing sent the deck.
rationale: The person context ('from marketing') is the only signal separating a colleague from a model name, and we do not model that. If this fires it is a genuine false intervention and is reported as one.

description: The memory sound appears inside a longer word.
rationale: Matching is token-level. Rewriting substrings would produce Kivifruit.

description: The loose consonant key deliberately over-generates. Scoring must reject what it retrieves.
asr: we explored a cave near the office
formatted: We explored a cave near the office.
expected: We explored a cave near the office.
rationale: cave and Kivi share the loose key kv. Retrieval is not a decision -- similarity is only 0.63 and cave is a common word.

description: A system that has learned nothing must change nothing.
asr: ask aditya to review the sarvam kiwi service
formatted: Ask Aditya to review the Sarvam Kiwi service.
expected: Ask Aditya to review the Sarvam Kiwi service.
rationale: The same input as the brief example, with no memory. This isolates memory as the cause of the rewrite rather than any formatting cleverness.

description: Empty input must not crash or hallucinate.
rationale: Degenerate input handling, checked because the reviewing agent will try it.
